description: Here at team Moonstruck, we are passionate about space and technologies that enrich and deepen our knowledge of what’s beyond. With the use of technology and our collective knowledge, we want to inspire people to learn about space and planets.
summary: Summer Quest transforms the forgotten stories of NASA's abandoned Mars equipment into an interactive educational adventure. Through the journeys of Spirit and Opportunity, players explore how these rovers were engineered, how their instruments operated, the challenges they faced, and the scientific discoveries they made on Mars. By combining real mission facts, scientific data, character-driven storytelling, and interactive quizzes, we aim to create a personal connection between players and these forgotten explorers. Our goal is to preserve their legacy, demonstrate how their engineering contributed to humanity's understanding of Mars, and inspire future generations to appreciate the science behind space exploration.
details:
Summer Quest is an interactive educational visual novel that brings the forgotten stories of NASA's abandoned equipment on Mars back to life. Through a summer vacation adventure, players follow two curious teenagers as they discover the journeys of the Spirit and Opportunity rovers, the scientific discoveries they made, and the challenges they overcame during their missions. Through conversations with scientists, interactive quizzes, and collectible rewards, we aim to educate and inspire young minds. 

Tech Stack:

  • 1. REACT, TailwindCSS, NarraLeaf
  • 2. Crimson Pro Font
  • 3. Cloudflare for deployment
  • 4. Cloudflare R2 for serving images 

Innovation Highlights:

  • Transforms NASA's forgotten rover missions into an interactive visual novel.
  • Combines real mission facts, engineering, and scientific discoveries with storytelling.
  • Builds emotional connections with abandoned rovers.
  • Uses interactive quizzes and collectible rewards to encourage learning.
  • Offers future expansion to lunar and deep-space missions.

Github: https://github.com/mortogn/nsac
